shinyUI(

)

messages.subject: Re: tabsetPanel's whitout sidebar
parts: Thanks it is working as I wanted now.

El miércoles, 23 de octubre de 2013 11:35:42 UTC-5, ZJ escribió:
?shiny::basicPage

shinyUI(basicPage(
  tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel("tab1")
    ,tabPanel("tab2")
  )   
))
